location: Historic Supreme Court Chamber State Capitol Room E202 200 West 24th Street
title: The purpose of this meeting is to approve the calendar and discuss other items related to the 2027 General Session; update Management Council policies and handbooks; receive updates from LSO, task forces, and subcommittees; and discuss other issues pursuant to Management Council's statutory authority. A portion of this meeting will be held in executive session. The meeting will be held in person and remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov). A limited number of participants can sign up to provide public comment virtually for a specified agenda…
